transcript: Speaker A: 18 saal mein shaadi, 23 saal mein beva, beech mein paanch betiyan. Koi padhai nahi, koi job nahi. English ka ek word nahi aata. Abbu ne kaha beta hum boodhe hain, tumhein aur paanch bacchon ko kaise paaleinge? Maayke ka darwaza band ho gaya. Ek app ne zindagi ka darwaza khol diya. Mera naam Zara hai, Lucknow se. 18 mein shaadi, 23 mein beva, paanch betiyan. Koi padhai nahi, koi skill nahi, English ka 'E' bhi nahi aata tha. Bank mein do lakh the, mahine ka kharcha 18,000. 11 mahine, phir kuch nahi. Sasural ne bola humse nahi hoga. Maayke gayi, Abbu ne haath jod liye. Bole jagah nahi hai, paanch bacchon ko kaise rakhein ge? Main toot gayi, par paanch betiyan so rahi thi us kamre mein. Inke liye tootna allowed nahi tha. Naukri dhoondhi, call center mein opening thi 12,000 ki. Gayi, manager ne English mein baat ki. Main chup, ek word nahi nikla. Manager ne bola, 'Ma'am, we need someone who can speak basic English.' Waapas aa gayi, phir school gayi betiyon ka admission karwane. Form English mein tha, teacher English mein baat kar rahi thi. Maine bola, 'Deedi, Hindi mein samjha do.' Teacher ne ajeeb sa mooh banaya. Beti ne dekha, kuch nahi boli. Par us din samajh aayi, agar main English nahi seekhungi toh mere bacche bhi peeche raheinge. Ek raat phone pe English Seekho app ka ad dikha. Ek rupaye ka trial. Socha ek rupaye mein kya jaayega? Download kiya. Spoken English show dekha. Expert ne Hindi mein samjha ke English bolna sikhaya, basic se. Hello, Thank you, Excuse me. Phir, 'I need to check my bank balance.' 'My daughter needs admission in class 1.' 'Can you explain this form to me?' Wahi English seekhi jo meri zindagi mein chahiye thi. Bank wali English, school wali English, job wali English. Raat ko paanch betiyan sula kar AI coach se practice karti thi. Ghar mein sannata hota tha, main phone pe AI coach se English bolti thi. 'Good morning sir, I am calling about the job opening. My name is Zara. I have five years of experience in household management.' AI coach se seekha. Galat bolti thi, sudhaar deti thi. Sau baar sudhaar diya, kabhi nahi boli tumse nahi hoga. Meri sasural jaisi nahi thi woh, mere Abbu jaisi nahi thi woh. Do mahine mein basic English bol leti thi. Phir wahi call center mein gayi, wahi manager. Is baar boli, 'Good morning sir, I had applied earlier. I have been working on my English. I would like another chance.' Manager ne dekha, bola, 'Your English has improved. Welcome aboard.' 12,000 ki naukri mili. Phir Seekho par business section dekha. Meesho se re-selling seekhi. Part-time income mein WhatsApp channel banana seekha. Raat ko bacchon ko sula kar kaam karti. Naukri plus part-time, dono. Aaj teen saal ho gaye. Naukri mein promote hui, 22,000. Part-time se 12,000 aur, total 34,000 mahina. English ne naukri di, naukri ne paisa diya, paise ne izzat di. Paanch betiyan school mein hain, sab padh rahi hain. Teacher ab English mein baat karti hain, main English mein jawab deti hoon. Beti dekhti hai, muskuraati hai. Abbu pichle saal aaye, bole beta galti ho gayi. Tum itni chhoti thi, hum dar gaye the. Maine kaha Abbu, ab main kisi ka sahara nahi chahti. Main apni betiyon ka sahara khud hoon. English Seekho app download karo, expert ke videos dekho, AI coach se practice karo. Ek rupaye ka trial. Roz 15 minute, bacchon ko sula kar apne kamre mein, akele. Maa ban gayi ho toh sher ban jao, aur sher ko English aani chahiye, warna jangal mein bhi koi nahi sunta. [Speaker B: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo.] [Speaker A: Married at 18, widowed at 23, with five daughters in between. No education, no job. Didn't know a single word of English. Father said, 'We are old, how will we support you and five kids?' The door to my parents' home closed. But one app opened the door to life. My name is Zara, from Lucknow. Married at 18, widowed at 23, five daughters. No education, no skills, didn't even know the 'E' of English. Had 2 lakhs in the bank, monthly expenses were 18,000. 11 months, then nothing. In-laws said, 'We can't do this.' Went to my parents, father folded his hands. Said there's no space, how will we keep five kids? I broke down, but my five daughters were sleeping in that room. Breaking down was not allowed for them. Looked for a job, there was an opening at a call center for 12,000. Went, the manager spoke in English. I was quiet, not a word came out. The manager said, 'Ma'am, we need someone who can speak basic English.' Came back, then went to school for my daughters' admission. The form was in English, the teacher was speaking in English. I said, 'Sister, explain in Hindi.' The teacher made a strange face. My daughter saw, said nothing. But that day I understood, if I don't learn English, my kids will also lag behind. One night on my phone, I saw an ad for the English Seekho app. A one-rupee trial. Thought, what's there to lose in one rupee? Downloaded it. Watched the Spoken English show. The expert explained in Hindi and taught how to speak English, from the basics. Hello, Thank you, Excuse me. Then, 'I need to check my bank balance.' 'My daughter needs admission in class 1.' 'Can you explain this form to me?' Learned the exact English I needed in my life. Bank English, school English, job English. At night, after putting my five daughters to sleep, I practiced with the AI coach. The house would be silent, and I would speak English with the AI coach on my phone. 'Good morning sir, I am calling about the job opening. My name is Zara. I have five years of experience in household management.' Learned from the AI coach. If I spoke incorrectly, it corrected me. Corrected me a hundred times, never said 'you can't do it.' It wasn't like my in-laws, it wasn't like my father. In two months, I could speak basic English. Went back to the same call center, same manager. This time I said, 'Good morning sir, I had applied earlier. I have been working on my English. I would like another chance.' The manager looked and said, 'Your English has improved. Welcome aboard.' Got the 12,000 job. Then saw the business section on Seekho. Learned re-selling from Meesho. Learned to make a WhatsApp channel for part-time income. Worked at night after putting the kids to sleep. Job plus part-time, both. Today, it's been three years. Promoted at my job, 22,000. Another 12,000 from part-time, total 34,000 a month. English gave me a job, the job gave me money, money gave me respect. Five daughters are in school, all are studying. Teachers now speak in English, I reply in English. My daughter watches and smiles. Father came last year, said, 'Daughter, it was a mistake. You were so young, we got scared.' I said, 'Father, now I don't want anyone's support. I am my daughters' support myself.' Download the English Seekho app, watch expert videos, practice with the AI coach. One-rupee trial. 15 minutes daily, after putting the kids to sleep, in your room, alone.
